# dedalus_machine_executions (Data Source)



## Example Usage

```terraform
data "dedalus_machine_executions" "example_machine_executions" {
  machine_id = "dm-ecc2efdd-ddfa-31a9-c6f1-b833d337aa7c"
}
```
